notes: Spiny forest and the arid south-west: Ifaty, Mangily and Toliara (Long-tailed Ground-Roller, Subdesert Mesite, Lafresnaye's Vanga, Thamnornis, Running Coua, Verreaux's Coua, Archbold's Newtonia, Subdesert Brush-Warbler, Red-shouldered Vanga), Zombitse (Appert's Tetraka), Tsimanampetsotsa (flamingos) and the coast gulls. Hand-picked, because the model scores these birds near 0; ranges are set from memory and eBird province lists. Left out for lack of usable photos: Madagascar Plover.
